chapters.title: The Reincarnation
content: Kim Suho, a civil engineering student, falls asleep while studying for exams.
He wakes up in a medieval fantasy world inside a nobleman's mansion.
Suho discovers he has possessed the body of Lloyd Frontera, a lazy noble.
The original Lloyd was despised by everyone for his incompetence.
Suho learns that the family estate is completely bankrupt.
The Frontera family owes massive debts to dangerous people.
Suho's new father, Baron Frontera, is sick and unable to work.
The estate is falling apart with no money for repairs.
The servants have all left except for a few loyal workers.
Suho realizes he must use his engineering knowledge to survive.
He remembers everything from his past life as a student.
The fantasy world has similar physical laws to Earth.
Suho decides to rebuild the estate using modern knowledge.
Everyone thinks he is just a useless fool playing games.

chapters.title: The First Blueprint
content: Lloyd-Suho creates his first engineering blueprint on parchment.
He designs an irrigation system to save the dying crops.
The workers laugh at the strange drawings and plans.
Suho explains the concept of water flow and pressure.
Nobody understands the modern engineering principles.
Suho decides to demonstrate the system himself.
He gathers materials and begins construction with his own hands.
The workers are amazed by his sudden energy and knowledge.
The irrigation project takes several days to complete.
When finished, the crops flourish like never before.
The village is shocked by the miraculous transformation.
Baron Frontera hears about his son's unexpected success.
The baron feels proud of Lloyd for the first time.
Suho realizes that he can make a real difference here.

chapters.title: The Debt Collector
content: A group of debt collectors arrives at the Frontera estate.
They demand immediate payment of the family's debts.
The amount is impossible for the impoverished family to pay.
The collectors threaten to seize all the estate lands.
Suho steps forward to negotiate with the debtors.
He offers a plan to pay the debt in installments.
The collectors laugh at the suggestion from a foolish noble.
Suho presents his irrigation project as proof of his ability.
The collectors are impressed by the thriving crops.
They agree to give the Frontera family three months.
Suho promises to not only pay the debt but create wealth.
The collectors leave but watch the estate carefully.
Suho begins planning larger construction projects.
Time is now his greatest enemy in this new life.

chapters.title: The Fortress Wall
content: Monsters begin attacking the villages near the Frontera lands.
The estate lacks proper defenses against the invasions.
Suho decides to build a strong fortress wall around the area.
He designs a wall using principles of medieval fortification.
The design includes features never seen in this world.
Arrow slits, murder holes, and layered defenses are planned.
The villagers participate in construction with new hope.
Suho works alongside everyone as a leader and engineer.
The project uses local stone and innovative binding materials.
Within weeks, the wall begins to take shape impressively.
Bandits and monsters test the incomplete defenses.
The wall holds surprisingly well against the attacks.
Suho's reputation grows throughout the region.
People start calling him the Miracle Engineer.

chapters.title: The Underground City
content: Suho discovers an abandoned underground area beneath the estate.
The space is extensive and could house many people.
He plans to expand it into a secure underground city.
The underground city will protect villagers during monster attacks.
Suho uses his knowledge of urban planning for the design.
He creates ventilation systems using wind tunnels.
Water supply is designed using natural underground rivers.
Living quarters, storage, and defense positions are all planned.
The workers think the project is impossible and dangerous.
Suho insists and leads the excavation himself.
They encounter ancient ruins and mysterious artifacts.
The artifacts suggest someone built underground before.
Suho becomes curious about the history of the world.
He decides to continue construction despite the mysteries.

chapters.title: The Trade Alliance
content: The Frontera estate produces surplus goods from the improved lands.
Suho decides to establish trade relationships with cities.
He designs better roads and transportation systems.
The roads connect the estate to major trading routes.
Merchants begin visiting the estate more frequently.
Suho introduces modern trade concepts and agreements.
He establishes a trading post with fair pricing and quality goods.
The Frontera name becomes known for reliability.
Other nobles become jealous of the sudden success.
They send spies to discover the secrets of the estate.
Suho outsmarts the spies with clever misdirection.
The trade alliance grows stronger every passing day.
The estate finally has enough money to pay off debts.
Suho feels proud of his achievements in this new world.

chapters.title: The Dragon Attack
content: A dragon appears in the skies above the Frontera lands.
The creature burns villages and destroys everything in its path.
The people panic and beg Suho to save them.
Suho knows that normal defenses are useless against dragons.
He studies the dragon's behavior and patterns carefully.
Suho discovers that the dragon is wounded and desperate.
The creature attacks in predictable patterns despite its power.
Suho designs traps using his engineering knowledge.
He creates massive trebuchets and ballistae for defense.
The siege weapons are hidden throughout the landscape.
Suho lures the dragon into the trap with clever tactics.
The dragon falls into the prepared defenses and is captured.
Suho does not kill the dragon but negotiates with it.
The dragon agrees to leave in exchange for healing.

chapters.title: The Royal Summons
content: King's messengers arrive at the Frontera estate with urgent news.
The King has heard about the Miracle Engineer's achievements.
The capital faces a severe housing crisis and flooding problems.
The King requests Suho's presence to solve these issues.
Suho is nervous about the political implications.
He decides to go with a small group of trusted workers.
The journey to the capital is long and dangerous.
Suho encounters bandits and monsters along the way.
He uses his engineering knowledge to overcome obstacles.
Upon arrival, Suho is shocked by the city's condition.
Sewage floods the streets and buildings are collapsing.
The people live in terrible conditions throughout the capital.
Suho begins planning massive infrastructure projects.
The King grants him authority and resources to work.

chapters.title: The Grand Project
content: Suho designs an extensive underground sewage system for the capital.
The system includes pipes, treatment areas, and flood control.
He also plans new housing with modern structural support.
The King's nobles oppose the expensive and ambitious plans.
Suho convinces them with detailed presentations and models.
Construction begins across the entire capital city.
Workers from the Frontera estate lead the various projects.
Suho faces sabotage from corrupt nobles and rival engineers.
He uncovers a conspiracy to steal the project funds.
Suho exposes the corrupt nobles with clever evidence.
The King punishes the conspirators and supports Suho fully.
The project progresses faster than anyone expected.
New buildings rise and the sewage system transforms the city.
Suho becomes a hero to the common people of the capital.

chapters.title: The New Era
content: The capital city is completely transformed by Suho's work.
Diseases decrease significantly with proper sanitation.
New housing provides shelter for thousands of families.
The King declares Suho as the Royal Architect of the kingdom.
Suho returns to his family estate as a celebrated hero.
The Frontera name is now respected throughout the kingdom.
Suho uses his new position to help poor communities everywhere.
He establishes schools to teach engineering to commoners.
The knowledge will survive beyond his lifetime.
Suho reflects on his journey from a bullied student.
He has found purpose and fulfillment in this new world.
The estate is prosperous and the people are thriving.
Suho knows that more challenges will appear eventually.
He is ready to face anything with his knowledge and courage.
